title: console: every record page on a deployment without the approvals service logs two console errors for the designed 501 of GET /approvals/records/OBJECT/ID/lock (18.2.0 scaffold)
body:
Filing gate: ① user-visible defect in the shipped console (@objectstack/console@18.2.0), reproduced at a public door, with a named location.

- Business reason: the first thing a new user does after `npm create objectstack` is open a record in the Console. The blank scaffold composes no approvals service, so every record page they open prints two red errors in the browser console for an answer the console itself treats as expected. A developer debugging their own app reads it as a broken server. It is the noise objectui#4042 set out to remove ("HTTP request failed" lines for requests that were never going to succeed).
- Who acts: the seat owning ui/packages/app-shell (src/hooks/useRecordApprovals.ts, the readLock path) and the @objectstack/client logger it reads through. Possible fixes: skip the lock read when the requests read already showed no approvals service, read the lock with the hook's own fetchJson, which does not log, or have the client not log a 501 the caller declares expected. Alternatively the server side makes the two approvals doors agree (see below).
- Dedupe (open and closed): "console record page approvals lock 501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED console error without approvals service" gave 50 hits (top 10 read), and "console HTTP request failed 501 Not Implemented console error approvals service not configured" gave 6. None reports this. #25934 and #26314 (closed) introduced the lock read.

reach: the Console on a fresh 18.2.0 scaffold (npm create objectstack@18.2.0), measured on 3 loads plus a second scaffold.
QA-source: #26629 · smoke:npm-18.2.0 · F5
type: Bug

## Reproduction (published 18.2.0)

1. npm create objectstack@18.2.0 my-app; cd my-app; npx os dev -p PORT (SQLite; the scaffold composes no approvals service).
2. Sign in at /_console/ as the seeded dev admin, open /_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/my_app_note, click New and save. Or open an existing note's panel with ?recordId=ID.
3. The browser console shows, on every open:
   - Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 501 (Not Implemented)
   - HTTP request failed: GET /api/v1/approvals/records/my_app_note/ID/lock -> 501 [NOT_IMPLEMENTED]
4. Server side: GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?object=my_app_note&recordId=ID answers 200 {"data":[]}, and GET /api/v1/approvals/records/my_app_note/ID/lock answers 501 {"code":"NOT_IMPLEMENTED","message":"Approvals service is not configured on this deployment"}.

Expected: no console error. useRecordApprovals.ts (27f38ada) documents the 501 as the designed answer of "a composition without the approvals service" and treats it as "not locked". Actual: two error-level lines per record open. The record itself saves and reads back fine.

Because the requests door answers 200, the hook takes the service to be present and goes on to the lock read. The two doors disagree on whether the service exists.

Full evidence chain: the run record #26629, cell F5.
